name: enjoy-the-journey
description: Enjoy the Journey - a road trip planner that turns long drives into days full of great stops.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @journey/shared && npm run build -w @journey/api && npm run build -w @journey/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @journey/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @journey/shared" "npm run dev -w @journey/api" "npm run dev -w @journey/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @journey/shared && npm test -w @journey/api && npm test -w @journey/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @journey/shared && npm run typecheck -w @journey/api && npm run typecheck -w @journey/web
